permissions._comment: Most permission logic lives in hooks (auto-approve.sh, pre-bash.sh). Only durable, team-wide allows belong here. 'gh api *' is intentionally NOT here: it allows mutating verbs that no hook screens, so it stays a per-user opt-in in settings.local.json.
